# Channel Rules

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build_channel_rules.py from brand_packs/*.yaml. Do not edit by hand; edit the brand pack and regenerate. -->

Summary of the 11 brand packs. The YAML files are the source of truth and the
pipeline lint (`studio/stages/policy.py`) enforces `red_lines` and `banned_templates`.
Every channel is faceless with an AI-generated voice and AI-disclosed. Adult channels are Not made for kids; kids pilots (made_for_kids: true, e.g. plinkety-pond) are accurately classified as made for kids and stay local-only until a reviewed kids publishing path exists.

## Rules for every channel

Red lines:

Banned phrases (any field, case-insensitive): `hey guys`, `welcome back to`, `in this video`, `smash that like`, `like and subscribe`, `don't forget to subscribe`.

## Channels

### Business Model Files (`business-model-files`, @businessmodelfiles)

- **Niche:** How well-known US companies actually make money, from public filings
- **Voice:** Kokoro `am_onyx` at speed 1.05
- **Visual style** (appended to every image prompt; do not paste it): documentary case-file style, manila folder #E8D3A2 paper texture, black #111111 type, ledger green #2F6B4F chart lines, top-down desk photo look, no real company logos
- **Hook styles** (patterns, not lines to copy; examples with numbers still need sources):
  - contrarian: 'Costco doesn't make its money on groceries.'
  - curiosity gap: 'Nobody talks about who really pays for airport lounges.'
  - result first: open on the profit number stamped on a case file
  - question: 'How does a free app make 13 billion dollars?'
- **Channel red lines:**
  - no credential words or titles for the narrator or presenter (Dr, CFP, CPA, Attorney, Expert, Advisor, Guru, Pilot, Captain, Electrician, Contractor, Hacker) (13 §5)
  - no income guarantees or get-rich framing (FTC)
  - never kid-appealing; Not made for kids on every video (11 §5)
  - disclose affiliate links spoken and on screen before the endorsement (17)
  - not investment advice; never recommend buying or selling any security
  - figures come from public filings (10-K, earnings calls) and are cited
  - no reused TV or documentary footage
- **Extra banned phrases:** `without further ado`, `let's dive in`, `thanks for watching`, `you should buy this stock`, `to the moon`

### Plinkety Pond (`plinkety-pond`, @plinketypond)

- **Niche:** Original sing-along nursery songs about gentle everyday routines (bath, teeth, nappy change, tidy-up, bedtime) for toddlers aged 2-4 watching with a caregiver, starring an original 3D clay-style otter family; UK English
- **Voice:** Kokoro `bf_emma` at speed 0.95
- **Visual style** (appended to every image prompt; do not paste it): soft rounded 3D clay and plush animation style, big expressive eyes, bright warm soft lighting, pastel pond teal #5EC8C0, buttercup yellow #FFD25E and coral #FF8C7A, cosy otter cottage, garden and pond-side park, slow gentle camera, calm toddler-friendly mood, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark
- **Hook styles** (patterns, not lines to copy; examples with numbers still need sources):
  - call-and-response opener: 'Is it bath time?' / 'Yes, it's bath time!'
  - onomatopoeia hook in the first bar: 'drip, drip, drop', 'pop, pop, pop', 'swish, swish'
  - counting hook: count three things on screen, slowly, one per beat
  - routine-first: open on the familiar moment (tap running, toothbrush, pyjamas), never a shock
- **Channel red lines:**
  - original characters, songs and lyrics only; never imitate CoComelon/JJ, Little Baby Bum, Pinkfong, Bebefinn, Super Simple or any other show's characters, melodies, logos or look (no melon or fruit motifs, no human toddler lead)
  - melodies are original or unquestionably public domain (e.g. Twinkle Twinkle, Baa Baa, Row Row Row Your Boat, London Bridge) and never a modern arrangement or recording
  - no dangerous imitable acts: no climbing, jumping into or standing in the bath, no running with toothbrushes, no small loose parts, no pulling cords, no water play without a grown-up in frame
  - a grown-up character is always present and supervising for bath, water, food and stairs scenes
  - no scary content: no villains, peril, loud stings, sudden zooms, darkness, crying-as-punishment or monsters
  - no commercial pressure: no product placement, no buy/unbox/ask-your-parents calls, no toys or brands named, no affiliate links
  - no manipulative engagement: no 'watch till the end', no fake rewards, no subscribe/like prompts aimed at children
  - gentle pacing: slow camera moves, no flashing or strobing light, no rapid colour flicker, soft audio levels
  - positive routines only; no shaming, teasing or humiliation; nappies and potty shown discreetly and kindly
  - no health, medical, sleep-training or developmental claims; not a substitute for caregiver advice
  - no realistic human children, no real people's likeness or voice; animal characters only
  - no text, letters or logos inside AI images; any labels are ffmpeg overlays
  - no credential words or titles for any character or narrator (Dr, Teacher, Expert, Nurse)
  - AI disclosure on every video; accurately classified as made for kids; never published by an agent
- **Extra banned phrases:** `hit the bell`, `ask your mum to buy`, `ask your parents to buy`, `buy it now`, `watch till the end`, `don't skip`, `only brave kids`, `if you're scared`
